doc_summary: A living entity's health writes: `living.set_health(host, health)` (`LivingEntity.setHealth`, cut to the maximum, no hook, never kills) and `living.heal(host, amount)` (`LivingEntity.heal`, through `living_heal`). Players, guests and mobs; false for armor stands and the dragon. `living.last_attacker(host)` (`LivingEntity.getLastHurtByMob`) reads who last hurt the entity, within a hundred ticks of the hurt, as an `EntityRef`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:living_health_writes@.
